logline: 冬天把想念放進骨頭裡。它不問你為什麼難過，只在夜裡把聲音收得更薄。
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 愁 — Winter Snow / Slow Mandarin Jazz

comics.en: Winter puts longing into the bone.
comics.zh: 冬天把想念放進骨頭裡。

comics.en: It does not ask why you ache.

comics.zh: 只在夜裡把聲音收得更薄。

comics.en: Listen for 愁 without saying everything.
